brief:
Israel removed signage from the British consulate in occupied East Jerusalem on Thursday, one month after Foreign Minister Israel Ben-Zvi ordered its closure, Al Jazeera English reported. The deadline set by Israel's government has now passed without the UK complying with the order to shut the facility.

Britain has not announced closure of the consulate, maintaining its diplomatic presence in the territory despite Israel's demand. The confrontation reflects escalating tensions between London and Jerusalem over the UK's stance on Palestinian rights and Israel's military operations.
dek: UK Foreign ⁠Minister ⁠Ed Miliband says consulate building will not be closing as Israeli deadline expires.
title: Israel removes UK consulate signage in East Jerusalem after deadline
